# Pinout

The RP2040 GPIO map is identical on both PCBs (spec §3, `layout/pins.py`). Symbol pin **names** are the authority; QFN pin numbers are informational. Electrical context is in [electrical.md](electrical.md), the key matrix in [matrix.md](matrix.md).

## Matrix GPIOs

Rows are inputs with an internal pull-down; columns are outputs (`col2row`). Both PCBs use the same nets. The right half's `.dts` lists the column GPIOs in reverse, so its logical column 0 is the inner column, and `col-offset = <7>` puts it at global column 7.

| Row net | GPIO | QFN |
|---|---|---|
| `ROW0` | GP8 | 11 |
| `ROW1` | GP9 | 12 |
| `ROW2` | GP10 | 13 |
| `ROW3` | GP11 | 14 |
| `ROW4` | GP12 | 15 |
| `ROW5` | GP13 | 16 |

| Col net | Physical column | GPIO | Left logical | Left global | Right logical | Right global |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `COL0` | C0 (outer) | GP14 | 0 | 0 | 6 | 13 |
| `COL1` | C1 | GP15 | 1 | 1 | 5 | 12 |
| `COL2` | C2 | GP16 | 2 | 2 | 4 | 11 |
| `COL3` | C3 | GP17 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 10 |
| `COL4` | C4 | GP18 | 4 | 4 | 2 | 9 |
| `COL5` | C5 | GP19 | 5 | 5 | 1 | 8 |
| `COL6` | C6 (inner) | GP20 | 6 | 6 | 0 | 7 |

## TRRS (split link)

UART0, GP0 TX and GP1 RX at 115200 baud, ZMK `zmk,wired-split`. Use a **straight** 4-pole cable: the TX/RX crossover is in the PCB netlist, so the firmware pinctrl is the same on both halves. **Never plug or unplug the TRRS cable while either half is powered.**

| Contact | Left PCB | Right PCB |
|---|---|---|
| Tip | `TRRS_A` = **UART_TX** | `TRRS_A` = **UART_RX** |
| Ring1 | `TRRS_B` = **UART_RX** | `TRRS_B` = **UART_TX** |
| Ring2 | `VLINK` | `VLINK` |
| Sleeve | `GND` | `GND` |

## Display header J3

1×5 2.54 mm female socket, hand-soldered (DNP at JLC). Pin 1 is at low x on **both** halves (the module is one part mounted face-up the same way; deviation WS0-5). The order is provisional until gate **G1** confirms the nice!view pinout.

| Pin | Function | Net | GPIO | Right frame (mm) | Left frame (mm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MOSI | `DISP_MOSI` | GP3 | (67.31, 40.6) | (182.53, 40.6) |
| 2 | SCK | `DISP_SCK` | GP2 | (69.85, 40.6) | (185.07, 40.6) |
| 3 | VCC | `3V3` | — | (72.39, 40.6) | (187.61, 40.6) |
| 4 | GND | `GND` | — | (74.93, 40.6) | (190.15, 40.6) |
| 5 | CS | `DISP_CS` | GP5 | (77.47, 40.6) | (192.69, 40.6) |
